_comment: Per-prize-block config. Baseline = day-of-week-adjusted rolling mean (level_window=45, full-history dow deviations), locked by a free grid search and robust over hundreds of origins. The TabPFN residual is fit per horizon. Robust validation (484 origins / 182 winter, retrained every 3 weeks) shows the residual helps days 1-5 (opsplus features, alpha=0.8: winter MSE 0.131->0.119) but NOT days 6-10 (operational signals too stale; baseline wins), so block_610 alpha=0. The block_610 feature_set is unused while alpha=0 but kept for transparency / easy re-enabling.
